findings.body: The stub releases the writer based only on attempt count, so successful recovery does not establish that Forge waited a few seconds. The later concurrent-command check verifies lock exclusion but imposes no minimum retry delay; a subsecond wait can still pass. Add command-level coverage that records timestamps at the app-server boundary and asserts the interval between resume attempts, or keeps the simulated writer active for a measured interval. This is required coverage for item 3 under the test-audit contract.
findings.title: Not done: test the few-second delay before the active-writer retry
